subject.title: fix(agents): send session_id affinity header to ChatGPT Responses backend

question: Should OpenClaw add a generated `session_id` header by default for native chatgpt.com Responses requests when the caller did not provide one?
rationale: The code path and live proof support the fix, but outbound provider header defaults are compatibility-sensitive and should be accepted by a human owner before merge.

options.title: Accept Scoped Native Header
options.body: Land this PR as-is once GitHub reports the head mergeable, keeping the generated header limited to native ChatGPT Responses and preserving caller overrides.

options.title: Require Broader Header Parity
options.body: Ask for a follow-up patch to align all ChatGPT/Codex session headers with the current Codex source before merge, trading a larger wire-surface change for stricter parity.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Native Header
recommendation.body: Land this PR as-is once GitHub reports the head mergeable, keeping the generated header limited to native ChatGPT Responses and preserving caller overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete most recently owned the reusable AI runtime extraction and adjacent ChatGPT Responses provider surface used as the local precedent.
